segment: The three defects of the publication transaction are repaired and proven: real beforeimages in one journal, a strict preimage chain, and the manifest bytes tied to the input's pins with the product's full composition check

1_beforeimages.was: the plugin and project file beforeimages were the candidate bytes, so the rollback could not restore the home's previous state; the rollback also covered only part of the operation
1_beforeimages.now: one journal holds every touched file: the real previous bytes of the home and the attributes needed to restore them; a file that did not exist before is recorded as absent and is removed again by the rollback; the receipt, the marker and the stamp are recorded the same way. The first recording of a path wins, so a file written twice is restored to its state before the operation
1_beforeimages.verified: four refusal scenarios on the isolated composition: after every refusal 0 changed files and 0 added files; the added plugin file is gone again and the changed plugin file carries its previous bytes

2_preimage_chain.was: a mismatch of the expected preimage was papered over by taking the layer's own declaration as the expected value
2_preimage_chain.now: the chain is strict: the receipt's hash for the first layer that touches a file, then the result hash of the preceding layer that touches it. The expected value is never replaced. A bundle that is already published is recognised by a separate check of its final bytes and of a consistent receipt, not by weakening the chain
2_preimage_chain.verified: the mismatching preimage is refused with transaction_layer_preimage_changed and the bench is unchanged

3_manifest_pins_and_composition.was: the manifest and patch bytes that were read were not tied to the hashes the current input pins, and only source_checked ran instead of the whole composition check
3_manifest_pins_and_composition.now: read_layers() refuses a manifest or patch whose bytes differ from the pinned hash, and the product's whole composition_checked runs: the source lock, the overlay set, the manifest digests, the patch digests and the source inventory together
3_manifest_pins_and_composition.verified: the changed manifest is refused with transaction_layer_manifest_pin_changed and the bench is unchanged

failure_paths_verified.bench: the full isolated composition (17888 files, 293 MB on the disk staging area) plus a small bench for the checks that do not need a complete inventory
scenarios: refusal during the plugin publication: the source files, the plugin set and the metadata are restored, the added plugin file disappears
refusal between two metadata writes: the receipt, the marker and the stamp are restored together
a layer whose preimage does not match the chain: refused before any write
candidate manifest bytes that differ from the pinned hash: refused before any write
failure_paths_verified.result: 4 of 4 scenarios refused with the expected reason and with 0 changed and 0 added files
failure_paths_verified.live_home: untouched: 184 layers, marker and receipt agree, the receiver still runs with pid 76953

entry_point.why: the old DSH-RESUME-2026-11-08 still pointed at friday-184 as the runtime home and at the data transfer and the repeated profile preparation, which would have repeated a completed transfer and destroyed the WAL, the archives and the access history
entry_point.old_file: kept unchanged as the historical handover of Kimi Code

wording_correction.was: a controlled failure after the publication restored every byte
wording_correction.now: the run of 2026-11-09 proved the rollback of the five source files only; the plugin publication and the metadata writes were not covered by it, and the journal then held the candidate bytes of the plugin and project files instead of the home's previous bytes. The full rollback of all stages is proven by the four scenarios of 2026-11-09
